title: Record the v1.0.0 promotion and orchestrate the next parallel cycle
purpose: Replace the obsolete pre-release governance checkpoint with a canonical state bound to the promoted Learn-it v1.0.0 baseline. Record CI-WP-001 as the only active implementation lane, ACC-WP-001 as deferred, the four independent read-only analysis lanes, and the accountable-owner arbitration gate that keeps all product implementation on HOLD.

roleBoundary.prohibitedScope: workflows, product code, runtime, tests, fixtures, authoring, kits, contracts, evidence and product documentation

invariants: The branch starts directly from exact commit 0604cad79a8ca765148c30090906b9f658af7109.
Learn-it v1.0.0 remains immutable at 84060 bytes with SHA-256 53ab18a61fdac152117a4c098bfa991c14970334bad00dffc9ae14fc2c1b0ef4.
The release retains the verdict RELEASE_PROMOTED_WITH_CONDITIONS and all permanent release conditions.
RC718 remains separately accessible and no RC718 learner data migration or compatibility layer is authorized.
CI-WP-001 is active only within the exact four paths recorded in issue #85 and its merge remains held pending independent QA and governor review.
ACC-WP-001 remains DEFERRED_BY_GOVERNOR and current keyboard, NVDA, Android and TalkBack behavior is a non-regression constraint.
PROD-WP-001 #88, ARC-WP-024 #89, LRN-WP-001 #90 and QA-WP-012 #91 are independent read-only analyses with no branch, PR or product-decision authority.
All product implementation remains on HOLD until the accountable owner arbitrates after the four analysis reports and the governor creates bounded disjoint work packages.
Writable overlap across active lanes remains zero paths.
Only the two allowed governance JSON files change.
The draft pull request is not a review, acceptance or merge authorization.
requiredEvidence: issue #85 CI-WP-001 authorization and four-path allowlist
issue #86 ACC-WP-001 deferment and non-regression conditions
issue #87 parallel-cycle authorization and convergence gate
main and both source blobs resolve to exact commit 0604cad79a8ca765148c30090906b9f658af7109
pull-request diff contains exactly governance/governor-state.json and work-packages/GOV-WP-017.json
adversarialTests: fail if the v1.0.0 commit, asset name, byte size or SHA-256 differs from the immutable baseline
fail if any permanent release condition is removed or weakened
fail if RC718 migration, compatibility or storage mutation is authorized
fail if CI-WP-001 is absent, inactive or granted paths beyond issue #85
fail if ACC-WP-001 is represented as active implementation
fail if any analysis lane is granted repository writes or product-decision authority
fail if product implementation is authorized before accountable-owner arbitration
fail if the next mandatory gate is not accountable-owner product arbitration
fail if writable overlap is non-zero
fail if any file outside the exact two-path allowlist changes
fail if the maintainer self-approves, merges or represents the draft PR as independently reviewed
nonGoals: change CI workflows or harness implementation
change product runtime, UX or learning behavior
consult or consolidate the conclusions of the independent analysis lanes
alter the v1.0.0 release or evidence chain
independentReview: verify the branch parent is exact commit 0604cad79a8ca765148c30090906b9f658af7109
verify the diff contains exactly the two allowed JSON paths
verify all issue statuses and release identities against GitHub
verify product implementation remains explicitly held
verify no release condition or accessibility reservation was lost
verify no self-certification or merge occurred
rollback: Close the draft pull request or revert the two-file governance commit. No workflow, product code, test, kit, contract, released artifact, learner data or RC718 data is changed.
